name: Answer Packet Pilot
purpose: Turn a reviewed answer candidate into a calm, copyable, source-carded pilot surface without production authority.

source.question: How can I act calmly when results are uncertain?
source.boundary: Reflection support, not therapy, ritual instruction, or production AI authority.

packet.title: Begin with the next honest action, not the result you cannot control.
packet.plain_meaning: The source candidate supports steadiness in action and caution about turning outcomes into identity.
packet.useful_action: Choose one small duty, do it slowly and cleanly, then stop measuring your worth by the result.
packet.no_go: Do not imply guaranteed calm, diagnosis, treatment, spiritual authority, or a direct Vedic quote.

review.reviewer_note: Source, family, confidence, and boundary are visible before any copy action.
review.founder_posture: Allowed as a static pilot surface. Production remains locked.
